नयी दिल्ली, पांच अक्टूबर (भाषा) अत्यधिक गर्मी का असर गर्भवती महिलाओं, शिशुओं और मातृत्व सेवाओं पर बढ़ता जा रहा है। 1,000 मातृ स्वास्थ्य सेवा पेशेवरों पर किये गए एक नये अंतरराष्ट्रीय सर्वेक्षण में यह बात सामने आई है।
सर्वेक्षण में पाया गया कि ऑस्ट्रेलिया, ब्राजील, भारत, ब्रिटेन और जिम्बाब्वे में सर्वेक्षण में शामिल 73 प्रतिशत लोगों ने बताया कि पिछले पांच वर्षों में गर्भवती महिलाओं को प्रभावित करने वाले गर्मी से संबंधित मामलों या अत्यधिक गर्मी से जुड़ी जटिलताओं में वृद्धि हुई है। यह सर्वेक्षण वैश्विक परोपकारी संस्था वेलकम के कहने पर कराया गया था और इसे सोमवार को जारी किया गया।
संयुक्त राष्ट्र के जलवायु प्रमुख साइमन स्टील ने एक बयान में कहा, ‘‘आज सामने आए नए आंकड़े… बेहद महत्वपूर्ण और गहरी चिंता पैदा करने वाले हैं। तस्वीर स्पष्ट और बेहद चिंताजनक है: जैसे-जैसे गर्मी बढ़ रही है, गर्भावस्था और प्रसव अब वैश्विक जलवायु संकट का एक नया गंभीर क्षेत्र बन गए हैं, जिसका संभावित रूप से घातक असर हो सकता है।’’
पांच में से चार से अधिक प्रतिभागियों (81 प्रतिशत) ने चिंता या गहरी चिंता जताई कि यदि अधिक कदम नहीं उठाए गए तो अत्यधिक गर्मी से माताओं, भ्रूण और नवजात शिशुओं का स्वास्थ्य तेजी से खतरे में पड़ सकता है।
सर्वेक्षण में पाया गया कि लगभग सभी प्रतिभागियों ने ऐसी गर्भवती महिला (98 प्रतिशत) या शिशु (99 प्रतिशत) की देखभाल की है, जिनके स्वास्थ्य पर उनके अनुसार भीषण गर्मी का असर पड़ा था।

सार
राजस्थान में सात अक्तूबर को मौसम शुष्क रहने का अनुमान है। मौसम विभाग ने प्रदेश के किसी भी जिले में बारिश को लेकर चेतावनी जारी नहीं की है। अगले एक सप्ताह तक बारिश की गतिविधियां नहीं होने और अधिकतम तापमान सामान्य से 2 से 4 डिग्री सेल्सियस अधिक रहने की संभावना है।
विज्ञापन
विस्तार
राजस्थान में सात अक्तूबर को मौसम पूरी तरह शुष्क रहने का अनुमान जताया गया है। मौसम विभाग ने राज्य के पूर्वी और पश्चिमी दोनों हिस्सों में बारिश की संभावना खारिज कर दी है। मौसम विभाग के बुलेटिन के अनुसार प्रदेश के किसी भी जिले में वर्षा को लेकर कोई चेतावनी जारी नहीं हुई है। सभी जिलों में चेतावनी का स्तर हरा यानी 'नो वार्निंग' तय किया गया है।
मौसम विभाग का चेतावनी मानचित्र दर्शाता है कि यह स्थिति सात अक्तूबर की सुबह 8:30 बजे तक लागू रहेगी। इसके साथ ही आगामी एक सप्ताह के दौरान राज्य भर में वर्षा की कोई गतिविधि देखने को नहीं मिलेगी और पूरे प्रदेश में मौसम साफ बना रहेगा।
तापमान में वृद्धि की संभावना
शुष्क मौसम के प्रभाव से राज्य में दिन के तापमान में तेजी से बढ़ोतरी देखने को मिल सकती है। प्रदेश में अधिकतम तापमान सामान्य से 2 से 4 डिग्री सेल्सियस ऊपर रहने की प्रबल संभावना है। विशेष रूप से दोपहर के समय तापमान में यह बढ़ोतरी दर्ज हो सकती है। जयपुर, अजमेर, कोटा, उदयपुर और जोधपुर में दिन के समय धूप खिली रहेगी। बारिश न होने के कारण दिन में हल्की गर्मी का प्रभाव बढ़ेगा और आने वाले दिनों में भी तापमान का यह बढ़ा हुआ स्तर बरकरार रहने की उम्मीद है।
विज्ञापन
पूर्वी राजस्थान में 28 जिलों का हाल
पूर्वी राजस्थान में 7 अक्तूबर को मौसम पूरी तरह साफ और शुष्क रहने वाला है। सभी 28 जिलों के लिए मौसम विभाग ने 'कोई चेतावनी नहीं' का निर्देश जारी किया है। जिन जिलों में मौसम शुष्क रहेगा, उनमें अजमेर, अलवर, बांसवाड़ा, बारां, ब्यावर, भरतपुर, भीलवाड़ा, बूंदी, चित्तौड़गढ़, दौसा, डीग, धौलपुर, डूंगरपुर, जयपुर, झालावाड़, झुंझुनूं, करौली, खैरथल-तिजारा, कोटा, कोटपुतली-बहरोड़, प्रतापगढ़, राजसमंद, सलूम्बर, सवाई माधोपुर, सीकर, सिरोही, टोंक और उदयपुर शामिल हैं। इन क्षेत्रों में आसमान मुख्यतः साफ रहेगा।

पश्चिमी राजस्थान की मौसमी स्थिति
पश्चिमी राजस्थान के सभी 13 जिलों में भी 7 अक्तूबर को मौसम शुष्क रहने का पूर्वानुमान है। मौसम विभाग ने इस भाग के किसी भी जिले के लिए किसी प्रकार की चेतावनी जारी नहीं की है और सभी जिले हरे रंग के 'नो वार्निंग' क्षेत्र में हैं। पश्चिमी राजस्थान के बालोतरा, बाड़मेर, बीकानेर, चूरू, डीडवाना-कुचामन, हनुमानगढ़, जैसलमेर, जालौर, जोधपुर, नागौर, पाली, फलौदी और श्रीगंगानगर जिलों में मौसम सामान्य और शुष्क बना रहेगा। जयपुर, अजमेर, कोटा, उदयपुर और जोधपुर जैसे प्रमुख जिलों में बारिश की कोई संभावना नहीं है।

मध्य अक्टूबर से तापमान सामान्य होने की संभावना
श्वेत शर्मा, नवांशहर। मानसून की विदाई के साथ शरद ऋतु की शुरुआत हो रही है। इस बार सितंबर के आखिरी दिनों में मौसम ने ऐसी करवट ली कि गर्मी के लिए पहचाने जाने वाले इस महीने में ठंड का अहसास होने लगा है।
अक्टूबर की शुरुआत में ही रात के तापमान में गिरावट आने से सुबह और देर रात हल्की ठंडक महसूस होने लगी है। कई लोगों को सुबह घर से निकलते समय मौसम में नवंबर जैसी ठंडक का अहसास हो रहा है।
हालांकि दिन के समय धूप निकलने के बाद गर्मी अभी बरकरार है। भारतीय मौसम विभाग (आईएमडी) चंडीगढ़ के नवांशहर मार्केट के आंकड़ों के अनुसार 1 अक्तूबर को न्यूनतम तापमान 21 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया, जबकि अधिकतम तापमान 35.4 डिग्री रहा।
नवांशहर में टूटा 6 साल का रिकॉर्ड
नवांशहर के उपलब्ध ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड में अक्तूबर 2018 के दौरान महीने का न्यूनतम तापमान 18.9 डिग्री सेल्सियस 25 अक्तूबर को दर्ज किया गया था। इस लिहाज से अक्तूबर की शुरुआत में 21 डिग्री तक पहुंचा न्यूनतम तापमान महीने के अंतिम सप्ताह में दर्ज होने वाले तापमान से काफी अधिक है।
इसलिए इसे सर्दी की दस्तक कहना अभी जल्दबाजी होगी, लेकिन सुबह-शाम बढ़ रही ठंडक मौसम के अगले चरण में प्रवेश का संकेत जरूर दे रही है।
अक्टूबर के पहले सप्ताह में रात का पारा 21 से 24 डिग्री के बीच
आईएमडी के आंकड़ों के अनुसार 1 अक्तूबर को नवांशहर में न्यूनतम तापमान 21.0 डिग्री, 2 अक्तूबर को 21.8 डिग्री, 3 अक्तूबर को 22.3 डिग्री, 4 अक्तूबर को भी 22.3 डिग्री और 5 अक्तूबर को 22.9 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहा।
यानी अक्तूबर के पहले सप्ताह में रात का तापमान लगातार 21 से 24 डिग्री के आसपास बना हुआ है। नवांशहर में 1 अक्तूबर को दिन का अधिकतम तापमान 33.4 डिग्री रहा।
2 अक्तूबर को यह बढ़कर 33.5, 3 अक्तूबर को 34.3 और 4 अक्तूबर को 34.1 डिग्री तथा 5 अक्तूबर को 34.3 डिग्री तक पहुंच गया। इससे स्पष्ट है कि रात और दिन के तापमान में अभी काफी अंतर बना हुआ है। दिन में तेज धूप के कारण गर्मी महसूस हो रही है, जबकि सूरज ढलने के बाद मौसम में तेजी से ठंडक बढ़ जाती है।
दोपहर में गर्मी रात में ठंड
दूसरी तरफ अक्टूबर महीने के शुरु हो जाने के बाद भी सोमवार को दिन में गर्मी रही। मौसम विभाग के बुलेटिन के मुताबिक नवांशहर में सोमवार दोपहर एक बजे का अधिकतम तापमान 33 डिग्री दर्ज हुआ।
आने वाले दिनों में भी मौसम के रूखे तेवर झेलने पड़ सकते हैं, लेकिन अक्तूबर के दूसरे हफ्ते में राहत मिल सकती है। दूसरी तरफ आमतौर पर सितंबर में मौसम में बदलाव के कारण सुबह और रात हल्की ठंडी हो जाती है, जिससे बिजली की मांग सामान्य हो जाती है, लेकिन इस बार सितंबर महीना खत्म हो जाने के बाद भी दिन के समय गर्मी है।
अगर नवांशहर में सबसे गर्म सितंबर महीने की बात करें तो यह रिकॉर्ड पिछले 5 साल में 2023 के नाम पर है जब सितंबर में दिन का अधिकतम तापमान 36 डिग्री तक चला गया था।
पिछले साल 2025 में सबसे ज्यादा अधिकतम तापमान 33 डिग्री, 2024 में 31 डिग्री, 2023 में 36 डिग्री, 2022 में 35 डिग्री और 2021 में 34 डिग्री रह चुका है।
मिड अक्टूबर से सामान्य तापमान होगा
मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र बलोवाल सोखड़ी के डायरेक्टर डा. मनमोहनजीत सिंह ने बताया कि यूपी में लो प्रेशर एरिया, डब्ल्यूडी के एक साथ प्रभाव से यह बदलाव आया है।
हालांकि मानसून विदाई 23 सितंबर को घोषित हुई थी लेकिन नवांशहर में मानसून की आधिकारिक विदाई इस बार 20 सितंबर के आस पास ही हो गई। अब अक्तूबर महीने की शुरुआत में नवांशहर में अगले 5 हलकी बारिश होने की संभावना है।
इसके बाद दिन के तापमान में गिरावट दर्ज की जाएगी। इस समय दिन के समय मानसून के बाद हवा और जमीन में नमी की भारी मात्रा के चलते उमस ने तापमान में बढ़ोतरी कर दी है। पहाड़ों में बर्फबारी से इस रीजन में सुबह-शाम का मौसम सुहाना बना हुआ है। मिड अक्टूबर से तापमान सामान्य होना शुरू होगा और उमस घटेगी।
आने वाले दिनों में होगी बारिश
मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र बलोवाल सोखड़ी के डायरेक्टर डा. मनमोहनजीत सिंह अगले 5 दिनों तक आंशिक रूप से बादल छाने तथा हल्की बारिश या गरज-चमक की संभावना भी जताई है।
मौसम में बदलाव के साथ सुबह की सैर करने वालों और दोपहिया वाहन चालकों को अब रात और सुबह हल्की ठंड महसूस होने लगी है। फिलहाल दिन के तापमान में ज्यादा गिरावट नहीं आई है, लेकिन अक्तूबर के दूसरे पखवाड़े में तापमान सामान्य होने के साथ उमस कम होने और सुबह-शाम की ठंडक बढ़ने की संभावना रहेगी।

full_text:
On the heels of a sweltering weekend that sent North Bay residents and visitors searching for ways to cool down, the National Weather Service on Monday, Oct. 5, extended a local heat advisory through most of the week.
Though no local temperature records were broken in recent days, according to National Weather Service meteorologist Dial Hoang, the heat wave brought temperatures well above seasonal averages. Temperatures peaked Saturday, reaching the high 90s and low 100s across the region.
Downtown Santa Rosa saw a high of 100 degrees on Saturday, as did Sonoma. Petaluma recorded 99 degrees, and the high was 98 degrees in Napa. The coast saw cooler temperatures near Bodega Bay, where highs reached the low 70s.
The heat is expected to linger. On Monday, forecasters extended an existing heat advisory through 10 p.m. Thursday.
Inland areas of Sonoma and Napa counties can expect daytime temperatures through Thursday to range from the mid-90s to the low 100s, about 15 degrees to 20 degrees above seasonal averages, Hoang said. Coastal areas along Highway 1 will see cooler weather.
There’s an elevated fire risk in the region, Hoang said, solely from the high temperatures. Despite low relative humidity at higher elevations overnight during the heat wave, a lack of winds in the forecast means the agency does not anticipate any red flag warnings for the region.
A Spare the Air alert from the Bay Area Air District remained in effect Monday and was extended to Tuesday, banning wood burning. The air quality is forecast to be unhealthy for people with respiratory issues, especially in the Santa Clara Valley and South Central Bay, the district said.
Forecasters predicted relief from the blistering heat will arrive Friday, and by Saturday temperatures across the inland North Bay valleys are expected to dip down to the lower 70s and mid-80s. Until then, Hoang said the weather service recommends people stay hydrated, try to stay in the shade and to save physical activity for cooler parts of the day.

Waa kuma Axmed Shide, Soomaaligii ugu horreeyay ee loo doorto xilka guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Itoobiya?
Golaha Wakiillada Itoobiya ayaa shalay Axmed Shide u doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha muddo shan sano ah.
Ayyalach Isheetee ayaa iyaduna loo doortay ku-xigeenka Guddoomiyaha Golaha.
Axmed Shide ayaa hore u soo noqday Wasiirka Maaliyadda Itoobiya, wuxuuna sidoo kale xilal kala duwan ka soo qabtay dowladda.
Wuxuu noqday qofkii labaad ee ugu muddada dheeraa intii uu xilka wasiirka maaliyadda qabtay, wuxuuna hayay xilkaas qiyaastii siddeed sano.
Kadib doorashadiisa, Axmed Shide ayaa loo dhaariyay xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada.
Waa kuma Axmed Shide?
Waa siyaasi muddo dheer ka soo dhex muuqday Siyaasadda Itoobiya, haatana waxa uu noqday qofkii ugu horreyay ee Soomaali ah ee qabta xilka guddoomiyaha golaha shacabka baaralamaanka dalka Itoobiya.
Axmed Shide waxaa uu culuumta Maareynta kheyraadka iyo xallinta khilaafaadka kusoo bartay Machad ku yaalla dalka Netherland. Kadib-na wuxuu shahaadada koowaad ee arrimaha horumarinta ka qaatay jaamcadda Salix ee dalka Britain.
Waxaa uu xilal kala duwan ka soo qabtay dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida ee dalka Itoobiya, oo ay ka mid yihiin ku xigeenka madaxa xafiiska beeraha iyo horumarinta deegaanada, gudoomiyihii guddiga arrimaha xoola dhaqatada oo uu ahaa sannadkii 2003-da iyo madaxa xafiiska wanaajinta adeegyada bulshada.
Nin lagu magacaabo Girma Gutema oo sheegay inay saaxiibo dhaw yihiin Axmed ayaa tilmaamay in AxmedShide uu ku soo barbaaray magaalada Nageyle ee dalka Itoobiya, halkaas oo uu ku soo qaatay waxabarashadiisa dugsiga hoose dhexe iyo dugsiga sare.
Sannadkii 2008, ayaa markii ugu horreeysay loo magacaabay Wasiirka Maaliyadda. Sidoo kale bishii Nofeembar ee 2016-kii waxa uu noqday Wasiirka Gaadiidka.
19 April 2018 waxaa loo dhaariyay inuu noqdo madaxa Xafiiska Arrimaha Isgaarsiinta Dowladda.
12-kii bishii August 2018-kiina waxaa uu noqday Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Shacabka Soomaaliyeed (SPDP) isagaoo baddalay madaxweynhii hore ee Dowlad Degaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya Cabdi Maxamuud Cumar.
Waxaa kale oo uu horay u soo noqday wasiirkii warfaafinta ee Itoobiya.
Xisbigiisa ayaa markii dambe la midobay xisbiga Burwaaqo taariikhda markii ay ahayd 1-dii bishii Diseembar 2019-kii.
Shide ayaa 16-kii bishii Oktoobar 2018-kii markale loo magacaacay Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Dhaqaalaha ee Itoobiya.
Shalay oo taariikhdu ahayd 5-ta Oktoobar 2026-ka, waxaa waxaa loo doortay Axmed guddoomiyaha golaha shacabka Itoobiya.
Dad badan oo falanqeeya arrimaha siyaasadda geeska Afrika ayaa ku tilmaamay noqoshada Axmed Shide ee guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Itoobiya mid taariikhi ah oo uu ku gaaray dedaal iyo kartidiisa.
Faysal Rooble oo ah xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaanka ee Bulshada Bariga Afrik, kana mid xubnaha ku matala Soomaaliya ayaa farrin uu ku qoray boggiisa Facebook isla markaana uu kaga hadlay guusha Axmed Shide waxaa uu ku yiri:
Jeclow ama ha jeclaan, jagada Mudane Axmed Shide qabtay waa dhacdo taariikh ah. Axmed Shide waxu goobtaas ku gaadhay qabiil ma ah ee waa karti shaqsi iyo sida u shaxda siyaasada u dheeley".
Dad badan oo isugu jira aqoonyahanno, siyaasiin iyo shacab Soomaali ah ayaa guusha Axmed ku tilmaamay mid taariikhi ah oo ay Soomaalidu ka gaartay siyaasadda dalka Itoobiya.

This dangerous, long-lasting heat wave persists across San Luis Obispo County and Santa Barbara County, including the Santa Lucia Mountains, Santa Ynez Mountains, and the Los Padres National Forest. Find Air conditioning and stay hydrated!

Over the weekend, Our Lady of Angels Church in Sherman Heights had to adjust its Mass schedule and location.
“Around noon, we noticed that it was way too hot to be inside,” Father Bernardo Lara said. “And that's when it hit me: for Sunday mass, it's going to be overcrowded. There's no way we're going to be able to be inside.”
Father Lara said he cut down the usual almost hourlong Mass to 30 minutes due to the heat, requiring him to keep things short or even remove some parts.
“However, I do also think that from time to time or in case of emergencies like this, I don't think people mind,” Father Lara said. “I think they actually appreciated it just because it's a rare thing. It's not an every week thing.”
Father Lara said Pope Francis had made warnings in the past about how the heat would get worse, especially for particular communities.
“Pope Francis always said that climate change was going to affect people in one way or another, particularly the poor communities, then those that are the lowest income.”
The church does have fans inside the historic church, but Father Lara said they are noisy, and at a certain point, they only blow hot air.
“We just celebrated 120 years with all of the community and the church building. For that reason, it's lacking in many benefits like insulation, AC,” Father Lara said. “So, we are actually planning ahead for the next year because I think this is going to get worse. We're not going to go back.”
Father Lara said overall attendance has not been affected.

SAN DIEGO, Calif. — SDG&E is asking residents to conserve electricity as extreme temperatures continue to hit San Diego County placing stress on the power grid.
“You know what? This is insane, man. It's like record-breaking heat in San Diego, being warmer than the desert during Santa Anas now we're saying something,” said Baron Partlow, who was cooling off at Pacific Beach Monday morning.
Partlow went to the beach to body surf and escape the heat.

On Monday morning, SDG&E's website showed no public safety power shutoffs were planned. The update came as welcome news for customers, including residents of Descanso, who lost power last week after the utility began shutting off electricity in some areas to help reduce wildfire risk.
At one point, SDG&E warned approximately 35,000 customers that their power could potentially be shut off. By Sunday, however, the utility said customers were no longer at risk of losing service.
“We understand how difficult extreme heat and power interruptions can be for our customers. Our operations teams are working around the clock to manage the electric system, and our crews are responding to outages as quickly and safely as possible," said SDG&E spokesman Anthony Wagner.
He said while energy supplies remain available, the extreme temperatures and high electricity demand are placing added stress on portions of the grid from 4 - 10 p.m.
"We are asking customers to conserve energy during these peak hours, including by delaying the use of large appliances, turning off electronics and adjusting your thermostat to 78°, health permitting. Every effort can help reduce stress on the system and support reliable service across the region," he said.
Partlow, who lives in Imperial Beach, said he could not remember the last time he experienced a blackout in his community. Still, the former firefighter said he understands why power shutoffs may be necessary during heat waves.
“The grid is always taxed and this extreme heat, it usually is such that they mandate. They almost have to.”
At Pacific Beach, some visitors took a swim to cool off, while others sought refuge indoors away from the beach.
"I'm going to Target and places with AC,” said Theresa.
Kerim Abadalecha, who was in San Diego on vacation from Arizona, said he was trying to avoid being outside during the hottest parts of the day.
“I stay indoor[s] and [do] evening time walking.”
The National Weather Service's extreme heat warning remains in effect for San Diego County through Thursday night as officials continue urging residents to take precautions and stay cool.

title: Disney World Park Ticket Prices Increase to New All-Time High of $229 for Christmas 2027 - Disney Tourist Blog
search_term: ("mercury soars" OR "mercury crosses" OR "temperature soars" OR "record temperature" OR "all-time high" OR "degrees Celsius" OR "maximum temperature" OR "hottest day" OR "temperature crosses 40" OR "temperature crosses 45" OR "temperature likely to rise") Andaman and Nicobar Islands
full_text:
Walt Disney World has raised ticket prices for November and December 2027, hitting new peak season record highs with a $20 year-over-year increase for the most expensive dates. On top of that, Magic Kingdom breaks the $200 barrier for almost all days during the final 2 months of the year! This post has pricing for 2026 vs. next year, details on the increases, and commentary offering our thoughts.
None of this is all that surprising. Price increases have been commonplace in recent years, predictably happening around the start of the new fiscal year in October. There are a couple ways this price increase is different than previous ones or even the increases on park tickets at Disneyland or the higher prices for Walt Disney World Annual Passes.
The first is that, unlike those, this is not immediate. If you were thinking about buying tickets as of yesterday for Columbus Day (whether this year or next), no need to kick yourself for the delay. The prices for both October 9, 2026 and October 9, 2027 are unchanged versus yesterday. The same goes for all other dates over the next two years.
The second is that this was inevitable, since Walt Disney World already increased January through October 2027 tickets (back in mid-April) and those showed year-over-year price increases from the time they were released. So really, this is a belated continuation of that, and mostly the same story.
Instead of being a price increase, it’s the launch of annual product at higher prices from the outset. That might be a distinction without a difference to you (higher prices are higher prices), but it is a deviation from Disney’s historical norm–or even what’s still done out at Disneyland.
The good news is that all of this has slowed considerably. Even as Walt Disney World’s annual product launches over the last few years have included price increases on hotels and park tickets, they’ve decelerated dramatically.
Prices are still increasing, just at a slower rate. The numbers from the last year-plus have been more consistent with inflation, and that goes for pretty much everything from restaurant menus to tickets. There still have been some 6-8% increases, but they’re less common than the 0-5% gains.
The additional good-ish news, at least for on-site guests, is that Walt Disney World has also ramped up discounts significantly in the last two years. Walt Disney World has effectively brought back the 2019 deal playbook and then some, offering discounts on par or better than that year after slim pickins’ between 2021 and early 2023.
Speaking of which, Walt Disney World has already released 4 special offers for early to mid-2027:
- Up to 30% Off Disney World Resort Room Discounts for Disney Visa in Winter & Spring 2027
- Save Up to $250 Per Night at Disney World in Winter to Summer 2027
- Save Up to 25% Off Disney World Resort Room Deal for January to Spring Break 2027
- Up to 35% Off Disney World AP Resort Discounts in Winter & Spring 2027
On top of that, it’s likely that there will be more deep discounts on rooms for Disney+ or Disney Visa Cardmembers in Winter and Summer 2027, and more ticket deals for the general public and Florida residents are likewise inevitable. The end result is an overall value proposition for 2027 that’s already pacing to be better than 2021-2023.
As a general matter, Walt Disney World’s date-based ticket pricing system makes price increases very difficult to assess. This variable pricing obfuscates changes by design, and it’s thus difficult for us to fully track price increases.
The good news is that, Walt Disney World does not appeared to have raised 2026 prices with the release of tickets for late 2027, so it’s a pretty easy before/after by comparing this year to 2027 on the official WDW ticket pricing calendar.
In addition to that, it does not appear that prices for multi-day tickets have increased at Walt Disney World for late 2027. Likewise, there are no changes to the price of parking or Lightning Lane Multi-Pass, although if there were to be price increases for LLMP, it’s equally likely that we’d see them around Christmas as opposed to October. (Last year, Walt Disney World did randomly raise the ceiling on Lightning Lane Multi-Pass in October, but that’s not the norm.)
As always, the most expensive dates of the year are in the last two weeks of the year. Here are the previous single-day ticket price ranges for 2026, which were released in two waves last year:
Now let’s turn to 2027 pricing, starting with the original January to October release, and then the new November and December 2027 rates:
Here are the existing single-day low ticket prices for January through October 2027:
These are still the price floors through 2027, with all of the cheapest dates occurring in August and September.
Here are the existing single-day peak ticket prices for January through October 2027:
Here are the NEW single-day peak ticket prices for November and December 2027:
The first thing you should notice is that none of the baseline prices increased. This isn’t particularly newsworthy, but it’s worth sharing and explaining because it’s often reported elsewhere that price floor is now higher. That analysis is misguided and misleading.
This is actually becoming a trend, and it’s due to Walt Disney World doing its annual product release in two waves: January through October in the earlier rollout, and then November and December in the subsequent release. The latter is what happened today, the former happened back in April.
The problem with that comparison is that December has the most expensive weeks of the year, and that’s true every single year. Additionally, November and December have none of the cheapest dates of the year, all of which are concentrated in August and September. Meaning there has been no increase for the lowest-priced tickets; they’re simply in those two months of 2027, which were previously released (and did not increase in price).
At the higher end of the spectrum, we actually do see increases to the ceiling, just as we did with the November and December releases for the last two years. But again, that’s because the weeks around Christmas and New Year’s Eve are the two most expensive of the year, which has been true as long as I can remember.
These peak week dates are up by $5 to $15 across the board, versus the previous highs set around Columbus Day 2027. However, the year over year increases are more substantial, as equivalent dates around Christmas and New Year’s Eve 2026 peak at $209 at Magic Kingdom and EPCOT, versus $229 in 2027.
This $20 year-over-year jump is uncommon, and limited to the last week-plus of the year. The record-high $229 priced dates are even more rare, with only December 25, 2027 and December 31, 2027 being priced at the $229 level for Magic Kingdom, and EPCOT hitting $229 only on NYE.
Perhaps more surprising than these peak dates being hiked $20 and hitting $229 is that pretty much the entirety of November and December 2027 received similar increases. In fact, Magic Kingdom now matches or exceeds this year’s high-water mark ($209) throughout the final two months of next year, with only November 7-11, 2027 and December 7-10, 2027 not breaking the $200 barrier. All other dates are $204 or higher, including many that will end up being shortened by the inevitable Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party (that’s insane).
In addition to that, Magic Kingdom hits its previous peak price of $219 from November 22-27, 2027 (Thanksgiving), various Saturdays in December, and then again starting December 18, 2027 through the remainder of the year. Some of those dates, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Eve Eve, are priced at $224 per day.
Speaking of which, here’s a look at pricing for December 31, 2027:
The biggest takeaway from 2027 ticket pricing as a whole is that most dates and parks are up around $5 to $10 year-over-year. Generalizing further, the average price increase is in the 3-4% range. This is not a hard and fast rule, and doesn’t impact all parks equally.
As far as price increases go, that’s not particularly exciting or surprising. This is now the second consecutive year of what’s essentially the “old normal” for price increases, which is to say on par with 2019 and earlier. The biggest differences are that 3-4% of a larger number is…also a larger number…so the dollar amounts are higher.
Not only that, but again, things like Lightning Lanes did not exist then, so any increase now is more than the 0% price increase on free FastPass back in the day. Ditto ground transportation vs. Disney’s Magical Express, etc.
It’s not surprising to see Walt Disney World push prices higher for November and December 2027, reaching a new record high. They already broke the $200 barrier last year, pushing past the psychological threshold without hesitation.
Despite the highest prices of the year, Christmas to New Year’s Eve remains the busiest week (and by a wide margin) of the year. If Disney really wanted to rip the band-aid off, they could probably push prices all the way to $250 without much issue.
Walt Disney World has exceedingly few opportunities for revenue growth right now; it’s hard to imagine them passing up higher prices for Christmas and New Year’s Eve due to the perception of higher prices. That is doubly true given the way ticket prices display, with the ceilings only showing to guests who actively search for those specific dates.
By contrast, everyone sees that $119 per day starting price, even if it is exceedingly difficult to find single-day tickets for that cost. (Hope you like Animal Kingdom in August!)
It seems fairly obvious that the guests who are purchasing the priciest options do not have the same degree of price sensitivity as the average guest or American consumer. I’m slightly surprised Walt Disney World is not taking full advantage of that, and instead has below-market prices for peak season dates.
Presumably, the reason Walt Disney World did not “rip off the band-aid” and push prices all the way to $224 (like Disneyland) or $250 (like the market might dictate) is because of optics. Increasing prices by that much in one fell swoop is a bad look, and precisely the kind of thing that contributed to the backlash against dearly-departed ex-CEO Bob Chapek. (One of many things.)
There are obviously other concerns, such as the ability to maintain high attendance and hotel occupancy. Increasing ticket prices too quickly risks unintended consequences, and Walt Disney World doesn’t want to end up in a situation where they exceed the breaking point of too many guests. This isn’t like the October 31st date of Mickey’s Not So Scary Halloween Party, which sells out with ease and exists somewhat in a vacuum. Slower price discovery on park tickets is pragmatic.
To the point about optics, there’s a new piece on how Walt Disney World is pricing out average middle class Americans or its own fans are finally reaching their breaking point almost every other week. This is increasingly common sentiment among both diehard Disney fans and the general public at large, and the backlash seems to be growing.
There’s a lot of validity to the perceptions that Walt Disney World is increasingly out of reach. This round of higher-priced tickets for Christmas 2027 will undoubtedly contribute to that, with the mainstream media likely to pounce on this news, too.
This might sound contradictory. On the one hand, it’s my perspective that the peak week from Christmas to New Year’s Eve is priced below-market. But that’s just objective reality, based on the available data–ticket sales, reservation availability, crowd levels, etc.
On the other hand, it is also my perspective that too many and too aggressive of price increases are not just bad optics, but detrimental to the long-term health of Walt Disney World. Even though they could push prices higher, that only applies to some products and for some dates. And it’s not without downside risk, even if those products do sell well and margins grow.
In fact, I would actually argue that most of those $119 dates are actually overpriced. I’ve said it before, but it still baffles me that Walt Disney World doesn’t offer $99 tickets to Animal Kingdom during those months. The marketing value alone strikes me as worth it, and it would help buoy attendance on dates that are downright dead.
Both of these points are doubly true when you consider how keen Disneyland is on touting its increased number of $104 dates. Those are available not just at DCA, but also at Disneyland. There actually far more of them than the $119 dates at Walt Disney World, and on dates when the park is often open from 8 am to 11 pm! (Some of Disneyland’s $104 dates are actually quite busy because they induce so much demand, as opposed to just rewarding existing off-season guests with lower prices.)
There’s also the reality that sticker prices only matter so much. They certainly do with 1-day tickets, which are a big seller and are seldom discounted. It’s a similar story with hard ticket events, like Mickey’s Not So Scary Halloween Party.
For almost everything else, special offers have become so common that raising the sticker prices is less meaningful; it’s the eventual deals are what matter more. With offers like the Deep Discount on Rooms Starting at $99 Per Night and 4-Park Walt Disney World Magic Ticket, recent prices were cheaper than they’ve been in years.
The thought process for 2027 prices is probably more of the same with the Kohl’s Model to pricing. Raise the sticker prices, capture the revenue that can be captured by doing that, and then offer discounts to backfill rooms and park attendance. It’s not necessarily a bad strategy; it’s one that works until it doesn’t.
The problem is that not everyone is reading sites like this, stalking disneyworld.com, waiting for the next special offer to drop to bring prices down to their level. Many people price out a vacation once, and view the price they see at face value–it either is acceptable or too high.
That’s it; they’re done. Either out or in right then. Others will see headlines about the new higher ticket prices in the New York Times, CNBC, or wherever, and opt out without even pricing out anything.
My concern is that there’s already growing economic uncertainty and travel trepediations, at the same time that consumer confidence dips, fears of a recession rise, gas prices climb, and international travel decreases. Of course, that’s in the here and now–things could be better or worse by 2027. Regardless of how that plays out, we want to reemphasize our strong belief that Walt Disney World needs to take a hard look at affordability for middle class American families.
More parents being able to afford to take their kids to Disney for a day is a good thing. For one thing, Walt Disney World absolutely needs that pipeline of young fans who grow up on the parks. Childless Disney Adults are a great and lucrative demo, but they’re fundamentally different.
For the future health of the fandom, the parks, and the company, Walt Disney World really needs to ensure parents keep bringing their young children on rite-of-passage trips at a formative age. I’d like to believe that is truly what Walt Disney would’ve wanted when he talked about middle class accessibility, as opposed to pretending he’d be upset about whatever personal pet peeves I have with pricing.

For comprehensive advice, the best place to start is our Walt Disney World Trip Planning Guide for everything you need to know!
Your Thoughts
What do you think of these Walt Disney World ticket price increases? Surprised that Magic Kingdom breaks $200 for almost all of November and December 2027? What about new peak pricing of $229 for Christmas Day and New Year’s Eve 2027? Will you still be visiting the parks next year, or are you priced out? Do you agree or disagree with our assessment? Any questions we can help you answer? Hearing your feedback–even when you disagree with us–is both interesting to us and helpful to other readers, so please share your thoughts below in the comments!
